## Description

<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:BEGIN -->
Seen once on GCE (Linux, perf batch 1's correctness run, 2026-10-20): extent_store::shuttle needs_closes_to_wait_for_writers ran 37 s and failed; its stderr ends with 'test panicked in task Tried to get ExecutionState, but got the following error: NotSet' and a failing schedule string. Locally (macOS) it passes in 0.4-0.7 s, 3 of 3. fails_without catches the run's panic and forgets its payload, but a panic outside a Shuttle run (a drop of a Shuttle object after the run, or a task torn down mid-panic) escapes. The schedule string is in the run's fxdax-tests.log (/var/folders/.../fxdax-gce.9SjIzx); shuttle::replay reproduces it.
<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:END -->

## Implementation Plan

<!-- SECTION:PLAN:BEGIN -->
Find whether the failure is a panic escaping a run or a missed search; fix the helpers that turn rules off.
<!-- SECTION:PLAN:END -->

## Implementation Notes

<!-- SECTION:NOTES:BEGIN -->
Failing schedule (pass to shuttle::replay): 

Cause: not an escaping panic. The 'NotSet' line is Shuttle's hook naming no task for fails_without's own 'no schedule failed' assertion (outside any run): 1,500 PCT schedules missed the window on that Linux run. Fix (commit 5904862): extent_store fails_without, fxdax fails_with and follower fails_alone retry up to 8 batches of new schedules (extent_store alternates PCT/Random); replay test takes SHUTTLE_RULES_OFF. macOS: extent_store shuttle 15/15, fxdax shuttle 15/15, follower shuttle 8/8. Linux verification (50/50, uffd callers compile) pending: gcloud auth expired.

Reproduced on Linux by stressing (nextest --stress-count): no escaping panic, but random searches missing (fails_without's 'no schedule failed'; reaching's 'unreached') and, separately, aborts: a task panicking while holding a Shuttle lock or an object whose drop takes one. Fixed in 5904862 (batches retried in extent_store fails_without, fxdax fails_with, follower fails_alone; SHUTTLE_RULES_OFF for replay) and 50bdc39 (reaching retried; checks panic with nothing held). Verified: Linux workspace 2245 passed + Shuttle suites (GCE, fxdax-test-t55); macOS scripts/test.sh passed; stress on Linux: fxdax/follower/extent_store lib Shuttle 100/100, extent_store tests/shuttle.rs 50/50; scripts/upstream-changes.py --check passed.
<!-- SECTION:NOTES:END -->

## Final Summary

<!-- SECTION:FINAL_SUMMARY:BEGIN -->
The flake was a random schedule search missing the failing schedule, not a panic escaping a run (the 'NotSet' line is Shuttle's hook naming no task for the helper's own assertion). Mutant checks and reachability checks now retry batches of fresh schedules (up to 8); tests panic with no Shuttle lock or lock-taking object held, which had aborted processes. Verified by Linux stress: all Shuttle suites 50-100 of 50-100.
<!-- SECTION:FINAL_SUMMARY:END -->
